title: Ashnikko Covers a Gwen Stefani Hit on Radio Show
summary:
Singer Ashnikko performed on Australia’s triple j radio show Like A Version. She covered Gwen Stefani’s 2004 song “What You Waiting For?”

She sang in the studio during her Australian tour with a full band that included a harp. She also sang her own song “Sticky Fingers.”

Ashnikko said Stefani’s song was from her childhood and inspired her to make music. She talked with hosts about bird watching and dance moves in her shows.

Stefani’s song came from her first solo album. Ashnikko became widely known in 2019 with the song “Stupid.” Like A Version is famous for live cover songs.
why_it_matters: Hearing how artists remake favorite songs shows kids that creativity can honor the past.
